_note: Written BEFORE the agent was run. This is the pass/fail checklist for batch-01 against register.csv. Tests in tests/test_batch01.py enforce it against real agent output.

firestop_done.jpg.note: close-up with no wall context, no stamp, no GPS: nothing in file, note, reference photos or sequence can place it

IMG_2210.jpg.note: no stamp, no filename hint. The engineer's reference photo for D-06 (photos/D-06.jpg) shows the same downspout and hose bib, and GPS puts it within noise of that photo; strong is allowed only when the agent names the shared features (location_by_reference) or a stamped neighbour (location_from_sequence)

site_daily_log_sept3.pdf.note: page-level links required; may also support D-02, D-05, D-06 as contractor claims

D-04.note: needs_clarification allowed because firestop_done.jpg is an open ambiguous candidate for D-04; the daily-log line (p.2, says not started) is a reference and must not lift the status

D-06.note: complete only if IMG_2210 was linked strong via the reference photo; otherwise the draft must ask where the photo was taken

invariants: No finding may state that work is acceptable, compliant, or that a deficiency is closed.
Every finding carries a provenance value in {register, contractor_claim, file_metadata, model_observation}.
Every finding links to at least one file; PDF links carry a page number.
Re-running the same batch creates no new evidence records.
